name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 20 hours starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 1.71 to 4.95 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
